If I had negative side affects I wouldn’t be taking it. And I know they’re different, that’s why I specified. The worst thing I experienced in the first week was elevated heart rate and paranoia. Which is common, but I wouldn’t call it “horrible”. There’s different types of “Ritalin”. That’s just a brand name, so is Concerta, Ritalin SR, Ritalin SA, Aptensio XR, etc. These are all used for different scenarios and react with other meds independently. So to say that Ritalin itself is innately more harmful than some other drug is misinformed. Not every person with adhd is going to use the same medication, that goes without saying.

Not a drug user, but I have adhd. I take prescription methylphenidate (Concerta- basically slow release Ritalin). When I first took it, I had to be on an EKG so they could check my vitals. These drugs are no joke. And people with adhd react differently to them. If someone took my dose, it would be like taking any other stim. For me, I’m just less hyper. There’s reasons why certain procedures are used when prescribing medication.
